zh.title: 颱風沙德爾逼近 8月26日多家航空公司取消及延後沖繩航班
zh.summary: 受颱風沙德爾影響；8月26日沖繩航班取消或延後；桃機共16航班取消
body: 受到颱風沙德爾影響，桃園國際機場公司表示，截至8月25日晚間6時，已知8月26日共有16班航班取消。取消航班包含樂桃航空、中華航空、長榮航空、星宇航空及泰國獅子航空等航空公司部分班機。
在沖繩航線方面，長榮航空宣布8月26日往返沖繩航班全天取消。桃園國際機場已知取消的班機包括長榮航空BR112與BR113、中華航空CI120與CI121、星宇航空JX890與JX891、泰國獅子航空SL380與SL381，以及樂桃航空6個航班。
此外，台灣虎航與星宇航空調整8月26日飛往沖繩的航班時間。台灣虎航IT230、IT231、IT288與IT289航班改為延後起飛；星宇航空往返台北及台中至沖繩之JX870、JX871、JX302與JX303航班亦均改為延後出發。

en.title: Typhoon Saudel Prompts Flight Cancellations and Delays to Okinawa for August 26
en.summary: Typhoon Saudel causes flight cancellations and delays on Okinawa routes for August 26.
body: Due to the impact of Typhoon Saudel, Taoyuan International Airport Corporation announced that 16 flights scheduled for August 26 have been canceled as of 6 p.m. on August 25. The affected carriers include Peach Aviation, China Airlines, EVA Air, STARLUX Airlines, and Thai Lion Air.

For Okinawa routes, EVA Air announced all flights between Taiwan and Okinawa on August 26 are canceled. Canceled flights at Taoyuan International Airport include EVA Air flights BR112 and BR113, China Airlines flights CI120 and CI121, STARLUX Airlines flights JX890 and JX891, Thai Lion Air flights SL380 and SL381, and six Peach Aviation flights.

In addition, Tigerair Taiwan and STARLUX Airlines adjusted departure times for several August 26 Okinawa flights. Tigerair Taiwan postponed flights IT230, IT231, IT288, and IT289, while STARLUX Airlines rescheduled flights JX870, JX871, JX302, and JX303 to depart later.

zh.title: SPEEA工會高票否決波音合約 成員授權罷工
zh.summary: SPEEA工會高票否決波音四年期合約；近九成成員授權工會發起罷工
body: 代表波音公司（Boeing）員工的航空航天專業工程人員協會（SPEEA）於2026年8月21日宣布，其大多數工會成員已投票否決資方提出的新合約方案。工會表示，若後續與波音的合約談判無法達成顯著改善，會員已高票授權工會在必要時發起罷工行動。
根據SPEEA公布的投票數據，本次共有11,339名專業單元成員與3,909名技術單元成員參與投票。其中，專業單元有64%的成員投下反對票，技術單元則有71%的成員否決該方案。此外，兩個部門均有近90%的投票成員授權工會在談判停滯時推動罷工等爭議行為。
這份被否決的四年期合約方案於2026年8月初提出，涵蓋約13,000名工程師與科學家，以及約4,000名技術工作人員。工會於聲明中強調，會員的投票結果明確顯示擬議條款未達期望標準，波音資方與工會之間的對話與談判必須持續進行。
SPEEA指出，數千名會員對波音領導層存在深層不信任，原因包含工會代表的職缺減少或移往外州與海外外包、生產品質與安全被讓位給交付時程、工程與技術決策遭到推翻或忽視，以及薪資調整無法追上通膨與航空航天就業市場趨勢等因素。
為釐清會員對下一階段方案的具體期待，SPEEA已向全體成員發出問卷調查，該調查將開放至2026年8月26日。工會談判團隊表示，未來數週將全力投入談判，目標是爭取到能完整反映全體SPEEA會員訴求的最佳合約方案。

en.title: Boeing SPEEA Union Rejects New Contract Offer and Authorizes Strike Action
en.summary: SPEEA members at Boeing reject a four-year contract offer and overwhelmingly authorize potential strike action.
body: The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) announced on August 21, 2026, that the majority of its unionized Boeing employees have voted to reject a new contract offer presented by the planemaker. The union confirmed that voting members overwhelmingly authorized leadership to call strike action if subsequent negotiations with Boeing do not produce significant improvements to the proposed agreement.

Detailed voting results released by SPEEA showed that 64% of members in the professional unit voted against the agreement, with 11,339 members casting ballots. In the technical unit, 71% of the 3,909 voting members rejected the offer. Furthermore, nearly 90% of participating members across both bargaining sectors voted to authorize the union to press ahead with industrial action if necessary.

Presented earlier in August 2026, the four-year proposal applied to approximately 13,000 engineers and scientists as well as around 4,000 technical personnel. SPEEA stated that the membership's votes demonstrated that the proposed contract terms fell short of expectations, reinforcing the union's position that formal negotiations with Boeing management must continue.

According to SPEEA, thousands of represented staff continue to express deep distrust toward Boeing leadership due to workplace experiences. Specific concerns identified by the union include the erosion and offshoring of bargaining-unit jobs, schedule priorities taking precedence over quality and safety, technical decisions being overruled or ignored, and salary growth failing to match inflation and aerospace job market trends.

In preparation for upcoming discussions with the employer, SPEEA has distributed a feedback survey to its membership to define the required terms for any future contract offer. The survey is scheduled to remain open until August 26, 2026, with the union's negotiation team committing to pursue an offer that reflects all represented voices.

zh.title: 韓國真航空釜山航空與首爾航空擬合併 預計2027年3月正式上路
zh.summary: 真航空與釜山航空及首爾航空同意合併；預計2027年3月上路；組建韓國最大廉航。
body: 南韓低成本航空公司真航空（Jin Air）、釜山航空（Air Busan）與首爾航空（Air Seoul）於2026年8月21日達成協議，決定合併為單一航空公司，並統一採用真航空品牌營運。在取得股東與監管機構批准的前提下，這家整合後的航空公司預計於2027年3月17日正式上路營運。
這次三家低成本航空公司的合併，是南韓航空業規模更大整合案的一環。大韓航空（Korean Air）與韓亞航空（Asiana Airlines）的合併計畫預計於2026年12月生效，屆時真航空、釜山航空及首爾航空將歸屬於共同所有權之下，進一步推動南韓航空業的市場重組。
以2025年底的機隊數據為基準，合併後的航空公司預計將擁有59架飛機，其中包括來自真航空的32架、釜山航空的21架以及首爾航空的6架。此一機隊規模將超越濟州航空（Jeju Air）的45架與德威航空（T'way Air）的47架，使新公司成為南韓機隊規模最大的低成本航空公司。
在樞紐與航線網路方面，真航空在首爾仁川國際機場（ICN）擁有強大的營運基礎，首爾航空則專注於首都圈國際航線，而釜山航空則在釜山金海國際機場（PUS）及南韓東南部區域發揮關鍵作用。業者表示，合併後將更有效連結仁川與釜山的營運，並強化區域機場的國際航線服務。
對旅客而言，合併後最直接的改變將是系統簡化。原本需要分別在三家航空公司網站查詢的預訂、票務、行動平台及機場報到系統，未來均預計統一整合至真航空平台。此外，公司亦計畫依據市場需求重新調整航線與班表，提升機隊在不同市場間靈活調配的效率。

en.title: Jin Air, Air Busan, and Air Seoul Agree to Merge into Single South Korean LCC
en.summary: Three South Korean budget carriers agree to merge under the Jin Air brand by March 2027.
body: South Korean low-cost carriers Jin Air, Air Busan, and Air Seoul reached an agreement on 21 August 2026 to merge into a single airline operating under the Jin Air brand. Subject to necessary shareholder and regulatory approvals, the integrated budget carrier is scheduled to officially launch combined operations on 17 March 2027.

The three-way budget airline integration forms part of a broader restructuring across South Korea's commercial aviation sector. The major merger between parent companies Korean Air and Asiana Airlines is scheduled to take effect in December 2026, bringing Jin Air, Air Busan, and Air Seoul under unified corporate ownership.

Based on fleet evaluations at the end of 2025, the combined airline is expected to operate a fleet of 59 aircraft, consisting of 32 aircraft from Jin Air, 21 from Air Busan, and six from Air Seoul. This fleet size will position the combined entity ahead of domestic low-cost competitors Jeju Air with 45 aircraft and T'way Air with 47 aircraft, creating South Korea's largest budget carrier.

Each of the three carriers contributes distinct hub strengths to the consolidated network. Jin Air maintains a major presence at Seoul-Incheon Airport (ICN), Air Seoul operates an international route network centered on the Seoul metropolitan area, and Air Busan plays a primary role at Busan Gimhae International Airport (PUS) serving the southeastern region. The airlines plan to connect Incheon and Busan operations while strengthening international flights from regional hubs.

For air travelers, the operational merger will consolidate customer-facing services, with reservation platforms, ticketing systems, mobile applications, and airport check-in processes expected to be unified under the Jin Air brand. The integrated management plans to reorganize routes and schedules based on market demand, enabling more flexible deployment of aircraft across the expanded domestic and international network.
